name: Test Harness & Smoke Tests
description: Vitest test harness providing configuration, setup, and smoke tests for the exemplar.tools documentation site. Encompasses: (1) vite.config.ts test block configuration (jsdom environment, globals, setupFiles, include globs), (2) src/__tests__/setup.ts importing @testing-library/jest-dom and registering cleanup in afterEach, (3) data smoke tests validating the canonical tools array (length, slug set, per-entry field constraints, kindex videoUrl absence), (4) component render smoke tests using @testing-library/react with Convex hook mocking and MemoryRouter wrapping. This component exports no types; it is a pure consumer of the Canonical Type Registry (ToolDef, ToolSlug, etc.) and presentational components.

functions.name: configureVitestBlock
functions.description: Adds or validates the `test` configuration block in vite.config.ts. Ensures environment is jsdom, globals are enabled, setupFiles references src/__tests__/setup.ts, and include globs cover all .test and .spec files under src/.

inputs.name: existingConfig
inputs.description: The current vite.config.ts exported configuration object, parsed as a dictionary.

error_cases.name: config_parse_error
error_cases.condition: existingConfig cannot be interpreted as a valid Vite configuration

error_cases.name: conflicting_test_block
error_cases.condition: existingConfig already contains a test block with incompatible settings (e.g., environment !== 'jsdom')

preconditions: existingConfig is a valid Vite UserConfig object
vite.config.ts exists at project root

structured_side_effects.description: Reads existing Vite configuration to merge test block
Writes updated Vite configuration with test block

functions.name: initializeSetupFile
functions.description: Creates src/__tests__/setup.ts with: triple-slash vitest/globals reference, @testing-library/jest-dom import, and afterEach cleanup hook.

inputs.name: setupFilePath
inputs.description: Filesystem path for the setup file. Must be 'src/__tests__/setup.ts'.

error_cases.name: directory_creation_failed
error_cases.condition: src/__tests__/ directory cannot be created due to filesystem permissions

error_cases.name: missing_jest_dom_dependency
error_cases.condition: @testing-library/jest-dom is not installed; import would fail at test time

preconditions: src/__tests__/ directory exists or can be created
@testing-library/jest-dom is installed as a devDependency
jsdom is installed as a devDependency
postconditions: File at setupFilePath exists and is valid TypeScript
File contains afterEach(() => { cleanup(); }) or equivalent

structured_side_effects.description: Creates or overwrites the vitest setup file with jest-dom matchers and cleanup hook

functions.name: runToolsArrayLengthTest
functions.description: Asserts that the imported canonical tools array (ToolDefList) contains exactly 11 entries.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.description: The canonical tools array imported from the data layer. Each element conforms to ToolDef.

error_cases.name: import_failure
error_cases.condition: tools array cannot be imported from the data layer module

error_cases.name: tools_not_array
error_cases.condition: Imported tools binding is not an array

preconditions: tools is imported from the tool-data component's canonical export

functions.name: runSlugSetEqualityTest
functions.description: Asserts the set of slug values in the tools array exactly matches the ToolSlug enum variants. Order-independent comparison.

inputs.name: expectedSlugs
inputs.description: The 11 expected slug strings corresponding to ToolSlug enum variants.

error_cases.name: duplicate_slugs
error_cases.condition: tools array contains duplicate slug values

error_cases.name: slug_field_missing
error_cases.condition: One or more entries in tools lack a slug field

preconditions: tools is a valid ToolDefList
expectedSlugs contains exactly 11 unique strings
postconditions: If verdict is 'pass', Set(tools.map(t => t.slug)) deep-equals Set(expectedSlugs)
If verdict is 'fail', the sets differ by at least one element

functions.name: runPerEntryFieldValidation
functions.description: Uses test.each(tools) to validate that every ToolDef entry satisfies: name (non-empty string), description (non-empty string), step (integer 1–11), version (non-empty string), accentColor (matches /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/), instructions (non-empty array where each element has title:string and bash:string).

inputs.name: validationRules
inputs.description: Array of ToolFieldValidationRule specifying which fields to check and how.

error_cases.name: unknown_field
error_cases.condition: A validationRule references a fieldName not present on ToolDef

error_cases.name: invalid_assertion_type
error_cases.condition: A validationRule specifies an assertionType not in FieldAssertionType

error_cases.name: regex_compile_error
error_cases.condition: A validationRule with assertionType 'regex_match' has an invalid pattern

preconditions: tools is a valid ToolDefList with length 11
validationRules covers all six required fields: name, description, step, version, accentColor, instructions
postconditions: If verdict is 'pass', every entry in tools satisfies all six field constraints
If verdict is 'fail', at least one entry violates at least one constraint

functions.name: runKindexVideoUrlAbsenceTest
functions.description: Locates the tool entry with slug 'kindex' in the tools array and asserts that its videoUrl property is undefined.

error_cases.name: kindex_not_found
error_cases.condition: No entry in tools has slug === 'kindex'

error_cases.name: multiple_kindex_entries
error_cases.condition: More than one entry in tools has slug === 'kindex'

preconditions: tools contains an entry with slug === 'kindex'
postconditions: If verdict is 'pass', the kindex entry's videoUrl is undefined
If verdict is 'fail', the kindex entry's videoUrl is defined (non-undefined)

functions.name: runComponentRenderSmokeTest
functions.description: Renders a leaf-level presentational React component using @testing-library/react's render(). Mocks Convex hooks via vi.mock('convex/react') if required. Wraps in <MemoryRouter> if the component uses React Router. Asserts the component produces DOM output matching the assertionSelector.

inputs.name: spec
inputs.description: Full specification for the component render test including component identity, wrapping requirements, props, and assertion target.

error_cases.name: component_import_failure
error_cases.condition: The component module cannot be resolved or imported

error_cases.name: render_exception
error_cases.condition: render() throws an unhandled exception (not a test failure, an infrastructure error)

error_cases.name: mock_setup_failure
error_cases.condition: vi.mock('convex/react') fails or does not properly intercept hooks

error_cases.name: assertion_selector_no_match
error_cases.condition: The assertionSelector does not match any element in the rendered DOM (treated as test failure, not error)

preconditions: The component identified by spec.componentName is importable
@testing-library/react is installed as a devDependency
If spec.requiresRouter is true, react-router-dom is installed
If spec.requiresConvexMock is true, vi.mock('convex/react') is called before render
postconditions: If verdict is 'pass', render() did not throw and DOM output matches assertionSelector
If verdict is 'fail', either render() threw or DOM output did not match

structured_side_effects.description: render() mutates the jsdom document by mounting React component tree

preconditions: vite.config.ts contains a valid test block (as produced by configureVitestBlock)
src/__tests__/setup.ts exists (as produced by initializeSetupFile)
All devDependencies are installed (as produced by installDevDependencies)
At least one .test.ts or .test.tsx file exists under src/

structured_side_effects.description: Vitest executes setup file before tests
Vitest discovers and reads test files
Component render tests mutate jsdom during execution
Vitest emits test results and diagnostics to console

invariants: The test harness exports zero types; all type usage is consumed from the Canonical Type Registry (tool-data component)
All package installation commands use 'bun add -d'; npm, yarn, and npx are never invoked
src/__tests__/setup.ts always contains a triple-slash reference to vitest/globals
The canonical tools array under test always contains exactly 11 entries
The set of slugs in the tools array corresponds 1:1 with ToolSlug enum variants
The kindex tool entry never has a defined videoUrl property
All test files reside under src/__tests__/ with .test.ts or .test.tsx extensions
Component render smoke tests clean up after each test via afterEach cleanup hook
Dev server port 4000 configuration in vite.config.ts is not altered by test block additions
Test suite total equals passed + failed + skipped with no unaccounted tests

data_access.rationale: Reads the canonical tools array (PUBLIC tier, no PII) from the tool-data component to validate structural integrity (array length, slug completeness, field presence/format). Reads React component source files (PUBLIC tier) to verify they render without errors. No data is written; all assertions are read-only evaluations against in-memory data structures and JSDOM state.

side_effects.rationale: Vitest reads source modules, configuration files, and the canonical data array to execute test assertions. All files are project source code classified as PUBLIC.

configureVitestBlock writes test configuration to vite.config.ts; initializeSetupFile writes the setup module; installDevDependencies updates package.json, lockfile, and node_modules. All targets are build/dev infrastructure files, PUBLIC classification.
installDevDependencies fetches package tarballs from the npm registry. Package names are public, no credentials or PII are transmitted beyond standard registry authentication tokens managed by bun.
executeTestSuite spawns a child process via bunx to run vitest. The process reads only PUBLIC project source files and outputs test results to stdout/stderr.
